review_scope: Eight primary-source leads; selected full-text methods/limitations for AVRI and CyberChainBench, metadata/abstract or page-level inspection for other leads. Not a complete frontier survey.
authority: Public-document research only. No third-party build/payload, provider protocol request, target execution or account interaction.
timestamp_boundary: Retrieval timestamps are the host clock, not qualified UTC.
retention_boundary: Exact public source bytes remain in ignored local artifacts; tracked metadata does not make them available in a fresh clone. New retrievals receive new identities.
peer_review_boundary: arXiv version metadata is retained; peer-reviewed publication was not independently established. Vendor claims remain attributed.

sources.title: Where Do the Tokens Go? Understanding and Reducing Costs in LLM Agents for Vulnerability Discovery
sources.review_depth: abstract, version metadata, selected full-text methods and limitations; no reproduction
sources.observation: Studies repeated analysis and billed model cost. The initial 200 traces reuse ten tasks; supplied harness entrypoints and crash-based criteria limit transfer.
sources.proposed_etzio_question: Can source-bound reusable evidence improve independently reproduced results per total cost under the same target and budget?
sources.limitations: Auxiliary costs and hardware/reviewer costs need separate accounting; no repeated-run generality or bounty-income evidence follows.
sources.next_review: Inspect full methodology, artifact release, exact model/scaffold identities, licenses and statistical validity before a bounded comparison.

sources.title: CyberChainBench: Can AI Agents Secure Smart Contracts Against Real-World On-Chain Vulnerabilities?
sources.review_depth: abstract, version metadata, selected full-text methods and limitations; no reproduction
sources.observation: Evaluates historical chain-state detect/exploit/patch tasks; limitations acknowledge contamination, restricted patch coverage and mostly single-transaction incidents.
sources.proposed_etzio_question: What exact state capture, oracle and licensing requirements make a small subset an independent comparator?
sources.limitations: Remote data/tool dependencies require explicit handling; local simulated asset changes are not bounties or received cash.
sources.next_review: Inspect full task manifest, subset denominators, withholding, remote dependencies and vulnerable/fixed/legitimate-transaction oracles.
